messages:
alex (AE): Starting runway thread for HorizonBank POC. Scope: document search + RAG + structured extraction. Need: golden set seed, scoring rules, security Q timeline, and billing cadence. Who's on it?

tariq (SE): I'll own the eval harness infra. Quick clarifying Qs: confirm data residency (VPC), max concurrency, preferred embedding model. Also: do we enforce chunk-size policy for RAG?

alex (AE): VPC-only for doc store. Concurrency small—up to 25 r/s with occasional spikes. Embeddings: customer prefers open-source but happy to use our managed embed endpoint. Chunk size: they want paragraphs preserved; recommend 512-token chunks.

nora (SalesEng): Proposal: 1) 10-day seed phase to build golden set (min 300 items across types), 2) prompt-tuning & safety checks, 3) 30-day pilot. On pricing: two options—flat POC credit or pay-as-you-go with credit cap.

kevin (PM): Draft success criteria (short bullets):
- Golden rubric >= 88%
- No blocker regressions (>5% drop) during pilot
- p95 latency for extraction flows < 350ms
- All security gates green
- Conversion trigger: sustained >50k tokens/day after pilot
We should lock scoring weights now.

nora (SalesEng): Suggested scoring JSON (draft):
```json
{
  "entity_match": 0.55,
  "semantic_summary": 0.30,
  "formatting_safety": 0.10,
  "timeout_penalty": 0.05
}
```
Entity match = exact slots with tolerance rules (dates normalized). Semantic summary uses embedding cosine >= 0.80.

ida (Security): From sec side: need DLP review, customer-managed KMS, egress ACLs, and signed DPIA. Timeline: we can answer standard sec questionnaire in 3 business days once legal input provided. Also insist on audit logs retained 180 days for this customer.

rachel (Finance): For HorizonBank, recommend $7k POC credit covering baseline usage (approx 300k tokens). If they chase dedicated, we can convert credit to first month commit. Overages billed monthly. We'll create a usage alert at 70% of credit.

redwood-bot (deploy): eval-harness: environment "horizon-seed" created. CI job queued.

kevin (PM): Operational rules for golden set:
- Minimum 300 seed items: 40% invoices, 30% contracts, 30% support docs
- Each golden entry tagged with owner and QC checksum
- Only PM + SE can approve additions during seed phase
- Golden set TTL: freeze during pilot; updates only after post-pilot review
This prevents accidental drift.

nora (SalesEng): On edge-cases: we need adversarial noisy inputs (OCR errors, redacted text, long multi-clause contracts). Add 25% noisy samples into seed.

tariq (SE): Harness plan: run 4 random seeds per prompt, persist raw outputs + embeddings + scores. Hash expected answers for privacy. Store per-batch metrics and attach to console dashboard. Regression gating: alert if rolling 7-day end-to-end metric drops > 5%. Auto-rollback not allowed for pilot (manual ops).

ida (Security): Confirm DLP scoping and KMS. Also we need MDR vendor contact for the bank — who owns that sync?

alex (AE): I'll loop in HorizonBank security lead today and get MDR vendor details.

rachel (Finance): Create invoice milestones for POC credit and conversion clause in the SOW. Also add clause: customer responsible for storage egress costs if they exceed >1M tokens/day.

kevin (PM): Acceptance checklist for kickoff (must all be green):
1) Seed golden set >= 300 + owner signoff
2) Scoring config uploaded to harness and validated
3) Security questionnaire answered + VPC peering scheduled
4) POC credit provisioned and billing alerts set
5) Pilot start date locked
Who can confirm each item?

nora (SalesEng): I'll confirm scoring config and seed items (today EOD).

tariq (SE): I'll validate harness config and dashboard wiring (tomorrow AM).

ida (Security): I'll start the sec questionnaire and aim for answers in 3 business days. KMS & audit retention OK.

rachel (Finance): I'll provision the $7k credit and set 70% alert.

alex (AE): Great. Meeting scheduled at 09:30 PT tomorrow for final signoffs. Agenda: finalize golden examples, lock scoring weights, confirm sec SOW language, and sign POC credit. Quick notes: keep prompt examples short and include expected normalization rules (dates, currencies).

kevin (PM): One last note on regression gates: decide whether to use absolute drop (>=5%) or relative z-score. Recommend absolute to keep it simple for the customer.

nora (SalesEng): Absolute works. OK team, I'll post seed sample CSV in this thread after lunch.

alex (AE): Thanks everyone. Quick action items: nora -> seed CSV, tariq -> harness deploy, ida -> sec Q timeline, rachel -> credit. Back here after lunch with artifacts. :white_check_mark:
